courseDetail.faq1A: Tap "Buy" — a Telegram bot opens with the card number. Pay, then send a screenshot of the receipt to the bot.
courseDetail.faq2A: After you send the receipt, an admin usually confirms it within 24 hours. Once confirmed, the course unlocks automatically.
courseDetail.faq3Q: How many times can I watch the course?
courseDetail.faq3A: Once purchased, you have unlimited access to the course — no time limit or view limit.
courseDetail.faq4Q: Can I try the course before buying?
courseDetail.faq4A: Yes — the first lesson of every course is fully open for free, so you can judge the quality beforehand.

teacherImport.title: Import from document
teacherImport.subtitle: Extract questions from a ZIP produced by the PyMuPDF script. The ZIP is opened in your browser — only the manifest, images and question text are sent to the server.
teacherImport.subject: Subject
teacherImport.dropHint: The ZIP from Rasm_ajratgich.py or scan_kesuvchi.py — or click to choose
teacherImport.resumed: {count} pages were already done — they will be skipped.
teacherImport.errorTooManyPages: The file has {pages} pages. The limit is {max}.
teacherImport.errorQuota: Daily import limit reached ({used}/{limit}). Try again tomorrow.
teacherImport.errorUpload: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
teacherImport.debugNote: In this mode nothing is sent to the server and no quota is used.
teacherImport.debugScanned: This page has no text layer (scanned). Text recognition will be added in a later stage.
teacherImport.debugLegend: Blue — column, green — block, yellow — candidate band, red — figure, grey — skipped
teacherImport.jobPending: Question structuring happens in the next stage.
teacherImport.manifestScanned: Scanned file: question text will be read from the page images in the next stage.
teacherImport.skippedImages: {count} images were skipped because they did not fit into 2 MB.

manifestError.NO_MANIFEST: manifest.json was not found in the ZIP. Upload the ZIP produced by the script unchanged.
manifestError.BAD_JSON: manifest.json is corrupted — it could not be read as JSON.
manifestError.BAD_VERSION: Unsupported manifest version ({detail}). Get the latest version of the script.
manifestError.UNKNOWN_LANG: Unknown language code in the manifest: “{detail}”. Fix ASL_TIL in the script.
manifestError.TOO_MANY_PAGES: The manifest has {detail} pages. The limit is {max}.
manifestError.UNSAFE_PATH: Unsafe file path in the manifest: “{detail}”.
manifestError.MISSING_FILE: A file listed in the manifest is missing from the ZIP: “{detail}”.
